_comment: TTTR Image Browser (page 1). AutoForm over ImageBrowserViewModel: a rating-filter choice above the reusable `image_browser` section — a file list (name + size + ★ rating badge), the per-file intensity mosaic as the image canvas with per-tile channel/micro-time labels, an editable annotation note, and a text filter. Ratings and annotations persist to .image_browser_meta.json; drop a folder to open it. Toolbar (Open/Clear/Caches/Export/TIFF/DOCX/Next) lives in the tool shell.

sections.label: Rating filter
sections.description: Show only files at/above (or exactly at) a star rating.

sections.title: Browser
sections.description: Pick a file to preview its detector-window intensity mosaic; rate ★ and annotate. Drop a folder to open it.
